en: Dependent on a state that leads to accumulation and is not-root, a state that does not lead to accumulation and is not-root arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: thirteen; under object: nine ... pe ... under resultant: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance: thirteen.

Dependent on a state that leads to accumulation and is not-root, a state that does not lead to disintegration and is not-root arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: nine ... pe ... under resultant: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance: nine.
